rust_oracle: rust-oracle.jsonl — 16 cases via live Store (rustc 1.98.1): staging/unverified_stage/json/not_verified/already_installed + reopen durability rows
ordering: create_stage: dir exists -> staging refusal verbatim
staged_manifest: read fail -> unverified_stage; parse/struct fail -> json

install_staged: gid=sha256(manifest bytes); target exists -> already_installed; inspect fail -> not_verified('snapshot inspection failed: ...'); production_ready guard; mkdir generations + rename + fsync_dir
installed_ids: sorted dir names; missing dir -> []; staging ghosts excluded
durability: same-fs rename + fsync of generations dir; reopen_ids/reopen_verify exercise a fresh Store on the same root (post-rename state observable). NOT a crash-durability proof — no fault injection between rename and fsync is possible in-process on Box; documented.
stricter_than_rust: request_id boundary (non-empty wellformed; no / \ NUL . ..) rejects escapes before mutation — Rust accepts arbitrary ids into stage_dir
comparison_policy: verbatim where deterministic; io/serde inner text by kind+prefix (documented delta)
also_fixed: stale post-fstat comment in generation_usable.mjs per REVIEW-NM-032-FINAL (comment only)
purity: local fs only; no official download/copy, no active pointer/decision/pin/retire/service/DB
untested_crash_cases: mid-rename crash, fsync failure, cross-device rename — not exercised (no fault injection available); overlayfs rename semantics assumed same-fs
review: REVIEW-NM-033-R2 — unpaired-surrogate path aliasing at native boundary

r1_fixes.utf8_sort: installedIds sorts via Buffer.compare on UTF-8 bytes (Rust Vec<String>::sort semantics); oracle case installed_ids_unicode pins [U+E000, U+10000] order
r1_fixes.atomic_noreplace: src_node/native/rename_noreplace.c — N-API binding to renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE); build: gcc -shared -fPIC -O2 -o rename_noreplace.node rename_noreplace.c -I/usr/include/node (libnode-dev headers, same toolchain recipe as P1 linux_guards; .node artifact not committed). Empty pre-created target -> EEXIST -> already_installed verbatim, stage+target intact (install_empty_target/target_still_empty/stage_preserved)
r1_fixes.exists_strict: exists() replaced by statOrNull — only ENOENT/ENOTDIR mean absent; other errors propagate as io. createStage uses atomic exclusive mkdirSync (EEXIST -> staging refusal) instead of exists+recursive-mkdir.

native_binding: rename_noreplace.c committed source; .node built at probe time (ABI-stable N-API); absence fails closed at module load

r2_fixes.native_nul: rename_noreplace.c now queries full UTF-8 length first, rejects >=4096, verifies complete copy and strlen==copied (embedded NUL -> EINVAL before syscall)
r2_fixes.direct_conflict: probe calls the native binding directly: NUL/long/non-string -> EINVAL; existing empty target -> EEXIST with both dirs intact; happy-path rename verified. Distinct from the store-precheck proof (install_empty_target)
r2_fixes.packaging_note: probe-time gcc build is development evidence only; production packaging is P6 — not claimed

r3_fix: rename_noreplace.c validates UTF-16 code units before UTF-8 conversion: lone high/low surrogate -> EINVAL (napi utf8 conversion would alias to U+FFFD); valid pairs allowed. Direct probes: sur-dir real-U+FFFD stays intact on both rejects; valid supplementary path renames.
fresh_build: .node rebuilt from committed C source for evidence collection; gitignored artifact
